name: BigBang-v1
context_scaling: Native 262,144 (base config max_position_embeddings). The card states no extension recipe and no trained context beyond the base model.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: hybrid stack of 10 full GQA attention layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 256) and 30 gated linear-attention layers, plus an MTP draft head the card leans on for speculative decoding.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-21. A post-training derivative of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: identical 35,951,822,704-parameter safetensors tensor set, same config.json, same 3B active budget. The card says it was trained on 10K synthetic tasks and publishes a single 12-column evaluation table. Every row beats the base column it prints, often by a wide margin (XBench 58.4 vs 32.6, SciCode-V-Main 50.0 vs 26.6, HLE 50.3 vs 36.2). Treat the SIZE of those gaps as the claim under test rather than the result: a 35B model at HLE 50.3 would sit above every open-weight model in this catalog, no harness settings are printed, and nothing has been independently reproduced. Recorded because it beats its own base on the card's own table and is being distributed at scale through a GGUF repack. Do not use these numbers to rank against other vendors.
